transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As we all know, we're here to discuss the six-week pilot to reduce classroom disruptions from student cell-phone use. The draft proposal currently covers grades 9 and 10, suggests placing phones in open classroom bins, and lists September 2, 2026, as the tentative launch date. Before I can approve the final scope, procedures, and launch record, I need to hear from each of you on any operational information. Could the participating teacher, counselor, and technology coordinator each report in?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd like to share some operational information from my own classroom. I ran a trial with all of my 9th-grade sections and recorded 23 phone-related interruptions in just two weeks. I also tested numbered locking pouches, and they significantly reduced interruptions. Based on that, I recommended a grade-9-only pilot using one pouch per student in my team notes — but those notes haven't been added to the draft proposal yet.
